title: Page 273
transc:
Homer NY
Sampson Balto  Wash'n Jany 21st 1865
Pilgrim MC Kim
Grapes Lucy Harsh plug for Shelter Van Vleet Vinton
zebra Send immy all the see weasles you can
chart her Pekin forth why of whiff Pedlar to
this port zodiac Have them well supplied with water
casks & C unity answer and give the names
and number you can send yoke Chas Thomas Actg
Belcher very bad day this sleet & snow prevail


WP Westervelt Phila  Washn Jany 21st 1865 
For Col Herman Biggs Phila
Send imm'y all the see
Steamers you can charter for
the transportation of troops to 
this port period Have them
well supplied with water casks
& C answer and give
the names and number you
can send sig Chas Thomas
Acting Quarter Master General end


G. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe  Washn Jany 21st 1865
Martha harsh plug for Mock Animal
Jupiter has started this evening on
his return Ewell wait for him
Indigo
